text: I do not need this right now, but I am interested next month. Please tell me the current price; do not book anything or call this a permanent rejection.
The current fee is four thousand nine hundred ninety nine rupees total. I will note your interest for next month. May I have your preferred name and email so I can follow up when you are ready?
Yes, I am still interested in future. I am not asking you to call me later right now. What should I know about the service?

It is a six week online course on weekdays from 7pm to 8pm, for age 18 and above. There is no placement or job guarantee and no income promise. Do you have any coding experience, or would you like to know anything else?
You have answered my questions. I do not need anything else. Goodbye, end the call.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
